title: 第一卷第7章 极境领域第一卷第8章 白甲银枪
content_zh:
;;
龙岭山脉，横亘在天地之间，雄伟而壮阔。
据说，这条山脉贯穿了整个东荒大陆。
这座山脉对于君无邪来说有着一段不堪回首的经历。
半年前，在这条山脉前，他被萧氏宗族的萧天命生生截取了一段脊柱骨，挖取了混沌神脉。
也是在这里，失去血脉后的他，被同族堂兄萧旭刺穿了心脏。
还是这座山脉，吞噬了他父亲的生命！
这里是他痛苦的开始，也是人生转折的节点。
他静静站了好久，拿出地图查看，随后选定方向，矫健的身影如猎豹般穿梭于山林间。
火焰谷，位于龙岭山脉前的一片火焰山内。
这片火山，常年熔浆不冷，温度奇高，里面生活着许多喜欢高温的火焰凶兽。
君无邪顶着滚滚热浪入了山，沿着地图上的路线深入。
时间不长，他就遇到了一头形似野猪，但背上却生着一排火焰骨刺的凶兽。
火焰兽。
二阶凶兽！
吼！
火焰兽在看到君无邪的瞬间咆哮着冲了上来，背上的骨刺火焰大盛，带着高温热浪袭来。
君无邪凝聚肉身血气于双拳，直面而上，大战瞬间爆发。
几十个回合下来，他心惊不已。
本来以为只是一头二阶初级的火焰兽，结果这家伙居然是二阶中级，境界相当于先天境六变的武者。

若是普通的先天境六变武者遇到它，恐怕撑不过三回合，但凶兽不同。
最终，他靠着准灵级强度的肉身与超强的持续作战力，耗尽火焰兽的真气，崩断了其利爪，才找准机会一击必杀。
“难怪那么多佣兵团折在火焰山，我才刚进来就遇到了这种二阶中级凶兽！”
君无邪有些疲累，喘着气看着躺在地上的火焰兽，其头颅上有个拳头大的窟窿，正是他给的致命一击。
“不行，我就这样继续深入的话，恐怕还没有见到火焰蟒就死在其他火焰兽的利爪下了……”
他有些犯难了，身上只有区区三十枚初灵丹，远远不够突破所需的资源。
现在没有办法提升境界！
他一边想着，一边用匕首剖开火焰兽的尸体，取出里面的兽核。
二阶以上的凶兽都有兽核，里面凝聚着凶兽大部分的能量。
这颗兽核有鸽蛋大小，通体火红，温度很高，有些烫手。
“应该能卖个好价钱了，最少值千金左右吧？”
兽核可以用来炼制丹药，城内三大商行常年收购。
“这种兽核，你可以直接作为修炼资源，效果比初灵丹强百倍，你居然想把它卖了？”
“前辈？这个不是只能用来炼丹么？”
君无邪听到神秘女子的话，心里不由一喜，兽核还有这样的效果？
不过他也很想说我穷啊，真的太穷了，穷到穿的衣服都打满了补丁。
“对于别人来说是，但不包括你。”神秘女子说道：“你修炼的元始金身诀有什么特性，你居然忘了？这颗兽核加上那三十枚初灵丹，可以让你冲击极境了。”
“嗯？极境，什么是极境？”
君无邪一脸茫然，还是首次听说极境。
后天境主炼体，到了第十变巅峰，接下来是先天境，中间最多也就隔了个所谓的半步先天境，这极境是什么境界？

神秘女子淡淡说道：“十变虽是巅峰，但并非终点。某些天资拔萃者可登峰而造极，踏入极境领域，每个大境界比他人多出一个特殊小境界，实力倍增。”
“这个极境可以增强一倍的实力？”
君无邪难以置信，极境这么恐怖？
“不错，你的极境更特殊，共有三个小境界：极境、极境小圆满、极境大圆满，可让你的肉身强度提升三倍。普通人一个大境界修炼十个小境界，而不管是出类拔萃者亦或是绝世之才皆只能修炼十一个。你不同，你需要修炼十三个，这是元始金身诀的特性，否则便无法突破下一境界。”
君无邪怔了怔，随后急忙找了个隐蔽的相对安全的地方，进入了永生神殿。
content_en:

The Longling Mountains, stretching between heaven and earth, are majestic and magnificent.
It is said that this mountain range runs through the entire Eastern Wilderness Continent.
This mountain range has an unbearable experience for Jun Wuxie.
Half a year ago, in front of this mountain range, a section of his spine was cut off by Xiao Tianming of the Xiao clan, and the Chaos Divine Vein was dug out.
It was also here that after losing his bloodline, he was pierced through the heart by his cousin Xiao Xu.
It was this mountain range that swallowed up his father's life!
This is the beginning of his pain and a turning point in his life.
He stood quietly for a long time, took out the map to check, and then chose a direction. His vigorous figure shuttled through the mountains and forests like a cheetah.
Flame Valley is located in the Flame Mountain in front of the Longling Mountains.
In this volcano, the lava does not get cold all year round and the temperature is extremely high. There are many flaming beasts that like high temperatures living in it.
Jun Wuxie braved the rolling heat wave and entered the mountain, following the route on the map.
Not long after, he encountered a ferocious beast that looked like a wild boar, but had a row of flaming bone spurs on its back.
Flame beast.
The second level ferocious beast!
roar!
The moment the flame beast saw Jun Wuxie, it roared and rushed forward. The bone spurs on its back were in flames, and it hit him with a high-temperature heat wave.
Jun Wuxie gathered the blood and energy of his body into his fists, faced him head-on, and the battle broke out instantly.
After dozens of rounds, he was extremely frightened.
I originally thought it was just a second-level elementary flame beast, but it turned out that this guy was actually a second-level intermediate, equivalent to a six-transformation warrior in the Xiantian Realm.
If an ordinary six-transformation warrior in the Xiantian realm encountered it, he might not be able to survive three rounds, but the ferocious beast was different.
In the end, he relied on his quasi-spiritual strength body and super continuous combat power to exhaust the flame beast's true energy and break its claws, and then found the right opportunity to kill it with one strike.
"No wonder so many mercenary groups are trapped in the Flame Mountain. I just came in and encountered this second-level intermediate ferocious beast!"
Jun Wuxie was a little tired, panting and looking at the flame beast lying on the ground. There was a fist-sized hole in its head, which was the fatal blow he had given.
"No, if I continue to go deeper like this, I'm afraid the flame python will die under the claws of other flame beasts before I see it..."
He was in some trouble. He only had thirty primary spirit pills on his body, which was far from enough resources for a breakthrough.
There is no way to improve your realm now!
While he was thinking, he used a dagger to cut open the body of the flame beast and take out the core of the beast inside.
The ferocious beasts of the second level and above all have beast cores, which contain most of the energy of the ferocious beasts.
This beast core is about the size of a pigeon egg, its body is fiery red, its temperature is very high, and it is a bit hot to the touch.
"It should be able to be sold for a good price, at least worth about a thousand gold, right?"
Beast cores can be used to refine elixirs, and the three major trading houses in the city purchase them all year round.
"You can use this kind of beast core directly as a cultivation resource, and its effect is a hundred times more powerful than the First Spirit Pill. You actually want to sell it?"
"Senior? Isn't this only used for refining elixirs?"
When Jun Wuxie heard the mysterious woman's words, she couldn't help but feel happy. The beast core could have such an effect?
But he also wanted to say that I was poor. I was so poor that the clothes I wore were all patched.
"For others, it is, but not you." The mysterious woman said: "What are the characteristics of the Yuanshi Golden Body Technique that you practiced, and you have forgotten it? This beast core plus the thirty first spirit pills can allow you to reach the extreme realm."
"Huh? Extreme realm, what is extreme realm?"
Jun Wuxie looked confused. This was the first time he heard about the extreme realm.
The Master of the Houtian Realm refines his body and reaches the peak of the tenth transformation. The next step is the Innate Realm. There is at most the so-called half-step Innate Realm in between. What is this extreme realm?
The mysterious woman said lightly: "Although the Ten Transformations are the pinnacle, they are not the end. Certain talented people can reach the peak and step into the extreme realm. Each major realm has a special smaller realm than others, doubling their strength."
"Can this extreme realm double the strength?"
Jun Wuxie couldn't believe it. The extreme state was so terrifying?
"Yes, your extreme realm is more special. There are three small realms: extreme realm, extreme small perfection, and extreme great perfection, which can triple the strength of your physical body. Ordinary people can cultivate ten small realms in one big realm, but no matter whether they are outstanding people or peerless talents, they can only cultivate eleven. You are different, you need to practice thirteen, which is the characteristic of Yuanshi Golden Body Art, otherwise you will not be able to break through to the next level. "
Jun Wuxie was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly found a hidden and relatively safe place and entered the Temple of Eternal Life.
